description: Deny mcp__plugin_agent-worktree_worktree__worktree_remove on a pkg/* checkout that is not clean and fully pushed to origin/<branch>, so run can never destroy a crashed session's unsalvaged work regardless of how its prose phrases the call (#84, mechanical backstop for #81's salvage-worktree.py). Fails closed with no Python 3 interpreter on PATH.

hooks.command: for py in python3 python py; do "$py" -c "import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info[0] != 3)" 2>/dev/null && exec "$py" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/run/worktree-remove-guard.py"; done; echo "worktree-remove-guard: denied — no Python 3 interpreter (python3/python/py) on PATH" >&2; exit 2
